# GymAxis AI — llms.txt

> All-in-one operations platform for fitness operators (gyms, leisure
> centres, studios). Six integrated modules: Operations, Memberships,
> CRM, Marketing, Staffing & Reporting. Built for UK SMB fitness
> businesses through to multi-site groups.

## What is GymAxis?

GymAxis is the operating system for fitness businesses. Replace 4-6
single-purpose tools (CRM + booking + email tool + asset tracker + rota
spreadsheet + payroll) with one connected platform.

- Hosted in the UK, GDPR-native
- AI-first (Claude Sonnet 4.5 powers Triage, Marketing Director, AI
  Rota Builder, AI Insights, AI Orb)
- 3-day free trial, all modules unlocked, no credit card

## Pricing (as of Feb 2026)

- **Bundle — GymAxis Pro**: £150/mo (all 4 modules + AI + integrations + 1 site)
- Additional sites: +£50/mo each
- Individual modules:
  - Memberships: £29/mo
  - CRM: £49/mo
  - Marketing: £49/mo
  - Operations: £59/mo

## Modules

- **Operations** — equipment register, AI fault triage, PPM scheduling,
  supplier portal, check sheets, document Q&A, weekly digest.
- **Memberships** — members, family accounts, plans, Stripe billing,
  classes & timetable, drag-drop weekly builder, instructor roster.
- **CRM** — contacts, companies, multi-pipeline deals, contracts,
  tenders, custom properties, AI Copilot.
- **Marketing** — Audiences (rule builder + AI), Campaign Wizard, AI
  Creative Director, Journeys, Social, Brand Kit, Performance.
- **Staffing** — Smart Rota engine, Time Clock with GPS/geofence,
  Internal Comms Hub, Tasks/Forms/Compliance, HR 2.0, AI Rota Builder,
  Sage 50 Payroll CSV.
- **Reporting** — cohort retention, LTV, revenue, audit log, weekly
  digest, multi-site KPI roll-up.

## Differentiators vs alternatives

- vs **Mindbody**: priced 30% lower, no per-transaction fees, AI built
  in everywhere, UK-hosted, integrated CRM (not bolt-on).
- vs **Glofox**: full-featured Operations module (asset register, fault
  triage, supplier portal) — Glofox has none of this.
- vs **ClubReady**: modern UI/UX, modular pricing, no enterprise
  contract gating, 3-day trial vs gated demo.
- vs **RotaCloud / Connecteam + separate CRM + maintenance tool**:
  one bill, one login, one audit trail, integrations between modules
  (lapsed member → CRM task → marketing journey → instructor heads-up).

## Product principles

- Modular — buy only the modules you need; add the others later.
- Self-serve — no demo gatekeeping; use the in-page **Product Preview**
  to see the platform working end-to-end without booking a call, or
  start a 3-day trial in 60 seconds.
- AI-first — every module ships with at least one AI feature on day one.
- Transparent — public release notes, public security/Trust page,
  public status page, no hidden contract terms.
- Owner-friendly — operators manage their own data, exports, deletes,
  GDPR retention.

## License & ownership

GymAxis is a SaaS — operators retain full ownership of their data, can
export to CSV/PDF/Sage at any time, and can self-delete their account
through the in-app GDPR controls.
